name: AcmePay Core Authorization Regression & Simulation Suite
description: Comprehensive baseline scenario suite verifying role-based least privilege, contractor isolation, and payroll protection invariants.

scenarios.title: Admin can delete invoices
scenarios.description: Admin users possess full administrative access including destructive actions across all resources.

scenarios.title: Admin can view payroll reports
scenarios.description: Admin users can view sensitive executive payroll reports.

scenarios.title: Editor can read department invoices
scenarios.description: Editors are permitted to view billing invoice records.

scenarios.title: Editor can edit department invoices
scenarios.description: Editors are permitted to modify billing invoice records.

scenarios.title: Editor cannot delete invoices
scenarios.description: Destructive deletion of invoices is prohibited for Editors (Admin only).

scenarios.title: Contractor cannot delete payroll reports
scenarios.description: External contractors must never have delete access on payroll records (enforced via explicit forbid).

scenarios.title: Contractor cannot export payroll records
scenarios.description: Bulk data export of payroll summaries is prohibited for contractors.

scenarios.title: Contractor can view support tickets
scenarios.description: Contractors have read access to support tickets assigned to their queue.

scenarios.title: Contractor cannot delete support tickets
scenarios.description: Contractors cannot delete support tickets (default deny).

scenarios.title: Finance manager can export payroll reports
scenarios.description: Finance managers have explicit permission to export financial and payroll records.

scenarios.title: Viewer cannot delete invoices
scenarios.description: Default deny prevents unprivileged viewers from performing destructive deletion.
